JEE Aspirant Dies in Kota; Family Seeks Answers

An 18-year-old student preparing for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) in Kota, Rajasthan, has died after allegedly jumping from a flyover. This incident marks the seventh student suicide in Kota this year, highlighting concerns about the pressures faced by students in competitive exam preparation hubs. The family of the deceased, who hailed from Bihar, is reportedly in shock and seeking clarity on the circumstances surrounding their child's death.
